Value DeFi is a yield aggregator built on smart contracts on public blockchains. Value DeFi pools user funds into vaults that deploy them into farming and liquidity strategies. Value DeFi operates without intermediaries and uses its own governance token.

Idle is a yield optimization protocol built on Ethereum smart contracts. Idle allocates deposited funds across lending markets to seek the best available yield. Idle operates without intermediaries as a non-custodial DeFi application.

Pickle Finance is a yield optimizer built on smart contracts on public blockchains. Pickle Finance auto-compounds rewards from liquidity pool tokens through vaults called jars. Pickle Finance operates without intermediaries and is governed through its own token.

Convex Finance is a yield booster built on Ethereum smart contracts. Convex Finance enhances rewards for users who deposit Curve liquidity pool tokens. Convex Finance operates without intermediaries and is linked to the locking of Curve governance tokens.
